guidelines.fragment_description: A Class can contain attributes and operations. This fragment includes all features that are considered part of the class's definition.
An Attribute is a defining property of a Class, specifying a named slot within which a value of a specified type may be stored.
An Operation is a behavioral feature of a Class that represents a functional service or computation.
An Association represents a relationship between two classes, indicating that objects of one class are connected to objects of another class.
Generalization is a relationship that indicates that one Class inherits from another Class, showing a hierarchy between the two.
A Dependency indicates that a change in one class may affect another class, reflecting a usage or implementation relationship.
Aggregation is a type of association that indicates a whole-part relationship between two classes.
Composition is a strong form of aggregation signifying a whole-part relationship, where the part is existentially dependent on the whole.

guidelines.fragment_description: A Class fragment represents a UML Class specification, including its name, attributes, and operations.
An Association represents a relationship between two UML Classes. It may include roles, multiplicities, and navigability.
An Aggregation is a special form of association that represents a whole-part relationship between two UML Classes.
A Composition is a strong form of aggregation that implies ownership and a whole-part relationship between two UML Classes.
Generalization represents an inheritance relationship between a more general class and a more specific class.
An Interface fragment details a UML Interface specification, including its name and operations.
A Realization relationship indicates that a class implements the operations defined by an interface.

guidelines.fragment_description: A Class represents a blueprint of objects containing attributes and operations specific to the object type it models.
An Association represents a relationship between two classes, indicating that objects of one class can be related to objects of the other class through a defined link.
An Aggregation represents a whole-part relationship between two classes where one class is a container and the other class is a part.
A Composition represents a strong whole-part relationship between two classes, indicating that the part cannot exist independently of the whole.
A Generalization represents an inheritance relationship between a more general superclass and more specific subclasses.
A Realization defines a relationship where a class implements the behavior specified by an interface.
A Dependency indicates that a change in one class (supplier) may require changes to the other class (client).
An Interface defines a set of operations that specify a contract for implementing classes but contains no implementation itself.
An Attribute is a stored property or data value of a class, representing characteristics shared by all instances of the class.
An Operation is a function or service that a class can provide, representing behavior of the objects within the class.

clusters.canonical_description: A UML Class defines the structure of objects with specified attributes and operations.
An Association indicates a relationship between two classes, showing how objects are connected.
An Aggregation is a special form of association representing a whole-part relationship between classes.
A Composition involves a strong whole-part relationship where the part is dependent on the whole class.
Generalization implies an inheritance relationship from a general superclass to more specific subclasses.
A Dependency indicates that a change in one class could require adjustments in a dependent class.
An Interface specifies a contract in terms of operations without implementing them.
A Realization defines how a class implements the operations of an interface.
An Attribute is a named property of a class representing its data value.
An Operation is a function or service that a class can execute.
